quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end or the road will become narrower.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or for through-traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the beginning of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A truck parking area is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used to communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm facing up and then swings their arm upward, it means increase your speed.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing down traffic.
Change lanes, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering from other roads. Move to another lane if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a complete stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be prepared to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about road conditions ahead.
Helps you find cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazardous conditions on or near the road. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider is turning right or moving to the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal used when riding in groups means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This keep right sign means there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs show railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is roadwork ahead. Turn right to detour.
The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply to the right. You should slow down before the curve, just like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with the palm down and swings it down to their side, it signals following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface is slippery during wet conditions.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic on the road you are entering pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming. Be alert for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way paths with a divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Be careful and ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming, so be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What is this sign used to prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter because the road is one-way. You would be entering from the wrong direction.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it tells the group to line up in single file.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers. The sign shows how many people must be in the vehicle.

questions.question: When a motorcycle operator's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle operators use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if a car is coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive through the intersection carefully, but you don't have to stop.
Stop only if you see traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Give the right-of-way to all other vehicles and pedestrians. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must move into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead only curves to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road curves to the right, then to the left.
The road curves to the left, then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves to the right, then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear right or left.
A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with care and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely and wait for other vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. Drivers must obey them. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you to be careful because the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the posted height limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop. You must yield the right-of-way and look both ways. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Watch for people at crosswalks and intersections, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Do not make a right turn when you see this sign.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane. Be prepared to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may touch or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive. In rain, snow, ice, or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?

options.text: The operator plans to turn left.
The operator is about to stop.
The operator plans to turn right.
The operator is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The operator plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals when they don't have mechanical turn signals. A bent left arm pointing upward tells other drivers the operator plans to turn right or move right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns drivers that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter that road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you should stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed to use when exiting a highway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you are not allowed to turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot turn right where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that there is construction or maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is your main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You can change lanes to go through the interchange, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and let trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that drivers in this lane must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers may use hand signals instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it signals that the driver plans to slow down or stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other traffic go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic go if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic go if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The fastest safe speed when conditions are good.
The fastest safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest safe speed when conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers may use hand signals instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the side, it signals that the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.
